Name: Building Replacer for Kenneth's Custom Shops - JCrown's Style
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]What is this mod?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This is a BUILDING REPLACER ONLY for all my custom shops. [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This pack is for players who still want to use the classic non-AI shop building style instead of the new AI buildings in my main shop mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All building assets in this pack are made by JCrown (Public Domain). I edited the building size/height in the content.json because JCrown's buildings are not the same size as the AI buildings, so it will fit perfectly now.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This is NOT a standalone mod. You still need my main shop mods for the shops to work.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's Inside This Page?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This page contains 8 separate ZIP files, one for each shop:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Bakery Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Dessert Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Drink Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Fruit Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Grocery Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Restaurant Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Vegetable Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Seed Shop Building - JCrown Style[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Each ZIP contains: content.json (with edited building size) + assets / building.png[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements: My Main Shop Mods (this replacer will NOT work without them). Content Patcher and SMAPI are already required by my main mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How To Use (For All 8 Shops):[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install my main shop mod first (ex: Kenneth's Bakery).[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Download the replacer you want from this page.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Open the ZIP - inside you will see a folder with the same name as my main shop mod (ex: Kenneth's Bakery folder). [/b][/size]
[size=4][b]   Just copy that folder and paste/overwrite it to your Mods folder. Click "Yes, Replace files" when asked.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This will replace the AI building with the classic JCrown version.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Run the game with SMAPI. Your shop will now use the classic non-AI building.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Replacer (Kenneth's Bakery folder) -> Paste to Mods/Kenneth's Bakery folder -> Overwrite[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Do the same for the other 7 shops - same method.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]To go back to AI building: Re-install my main shop mod.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Building Assets: JCrown (Public Domain)[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]- Edited & Re-packed by: Kenneth[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Enjoy the classic look![/b][/size]
